literal_meaning: জনগণের ঈশ্বর বা অধিদেবতা (জন + গণ + ঈশ)
figurative_meaning_en: The presiding deity of the people
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি জনগণেশের মতো জনসাধারণের প্রতিনিধিত্ব করেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He represents the people like Janaganesh.
The role of Janaganesh is crucial in society.
history: Coined by Rabindranath Tagore in his satirical work, referring to the overwhelming humor or power of the people's deity in a socio-political context.
note: This is a neologism by Tagore, blending 'jana' (people) and 'Ganesha' (lord of multitudes) to symbolize popular sovereignty or mass influence.
